title: Microsoft Purview Permission and Role Change Audit
app: Microsoft Purview scan and data-access events via the Purview REST API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=purview:scan (operation="*RoleAssignment*" OR operation="*Policy*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_principal
| sort - changes
description: Audits Microsoft Purview events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Microsoft Purview supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Microsoft Purview admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Microsoft Purview so unexpected changes can be traced.
